definitions.action_phase_assignment: Assign each policy_action to the phase on the latest sample whose sim_time is less than or equal to the action sim_time.
definitions.archive_frame_gap_sim_ms: Adjacent capture_sim_s gaps in camera/frames.jsonl. This is the throttled approximately 5 Hz archive recorder, not native camera cadence.
definitions.policy_capture_age_sim_ms: 1000 * policy_action.capture_age_sim_s; action acceptance sim_time minus originating capture timestamp, in the simulator timestamp domain.
definitions.policy_capture_gap_sim_ms: 1000 * policy_action.capture_interval_sim_s; gap between capture timestamps attached to consecutive accepted actions, not direct request-send cadence.
definitions.policy_latency_wall_ms: 1000 * policy_action.latency_wall_s; PolicyClient request submission to result acceptance, measured by the mission host monotonic clock. It includes local service/inference, exchange, and polling/scheduling time; it excludes image acquisition and any prior wait for an eligible frame.
definitions.sample_vision_age_sim_ms: 1000 * (sample.sim_time - sample.vision_stamp_sim_s); difference in the simulator timestamp domain.
definitions.setpoint_counts: summary.policy_setpoints_sent counts route-loop setpoints emitted while policy_active and an action reply exists. route_elapsed_sim_s starts at arming, before takeoff/hover, so this count divided by route duration is not a setpoint frequency; only the aggregate count is reported.

limitations: Simulator timestamp differences are not a real-time Jetson benchmark and do not include camera exposure/readout, OAK transport, Jetson scheduling/inference, or deployment networking.
policy_action logs accepted responses, not every request send; exact request cadence and unresolved requests are unavailable from these fields.

camera/frames.jsonl is an approximately 5 Hz archive and must not be used to infer native approximately 20 Hz navigation cadence; see docs/native-capture-gap-evidence.json for separate native timestamp evidence.
Summary setpoint count and route_elapsed_sim_s have different scopes; no setpoint rate is inferred.

native_capture_evidence.interpretation: Separate PX4 vehicle_visual_odometry timestamp_sample analysis in the cited evidence file (four closed logs, median positive gaps approximately 48-52 ms). These native timestamp results are not derived from the throttled archive frame log and are not an end-to-end inference benchmark.
